notes.title: The C4 Update! - v31.0
notes.content:
[p]Revolters get a brand-new gadget to play with! Blow up hatches and walls to create new pathways to success and get the drop on the ESTF operatives. Alongside this new gadget, we’re also bringing players a new round of balancing changes and a neat line-up of bug fixes.

Check the [url="https://www.breachersvr.com/discord"]Discord[/url] to see the full list of changes and improvements in detail.

The addition of C4 explosives on the Revolter side is bound to change the way players tackle the objective forever. Don’t believe it? Hop on and come C4 yourself!

- Increased pricing of the Flashbang from 300 to 400
- Decreased pricing of the Clone Projector from 400 to 300
- Increased Cyclone fire rate by 15%
- Increased Cadillo fire rate by 20%
- Increased Spectral price to 550

As always, let us know what you think about the new gadget, and the balancing changes in our [url="https://www.breachersvr.com/discord"]Discord[/url]. Any and all feedback is welcome!

Cheers, and see you in the game!

-TF[/p]

notes.title: New Roadmap, Playspacing Fix & More! - v30.2
notes.content: [h2]Say Hello to Our New Roadmap![/h2][p]We've heard your concerns & critiques surrounding our 2025 roadmap. As you can see at the bottom, we've got ourselves an improved roadmap in the main menu, it creates more clarity about the exciting things to come for Breachers![/p][p][b]Main Content Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Gadget: C4 (A Revolter Exclusive Gadget)[/p][/*][*][p]A Drone Rework[/p][/*][*][p]New Gadget: Spring Mine (An Enforcer Exclusive Gadget)[/p][/*][*][p]A Grenades Rework[/p][/*][*][p]Another New Gadget (Classified)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additional Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Account Linking[/p][/*][*][p]Kill Counter[/p][/*][*][p]Various QOL Changes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What are you most excited about?[/b][/p][p][img src="https://scontent.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/491830607_1017220510579858_1979256298456029251_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=B7CcURJ2o0cQ7kNvwEdzTD0&_nc_oc=AdndXp4ljakwh0IlY_9dfAE9omlioDZ7Sz6kpUhn7dO2JBZQPurlaxvGIz1jGob4aXfkIsiETl-kLOy6PNKkcytO&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AfToi_dy11phz0W1zq2hlG8D9jAFme3AS8H3M2hhL0OesQ&oe=6872AA2D"][/img][/p][h2]Playspacing: Why Did We Get Rid of It?[/h2][p]Playspacing (moving IRL & in-game simultaneously to gain an unfair advantage) has been a thing in Breachers for a long time, and we're aware that it's used a lot amongst high level, competitive & league players. We also understand many of you don’t mind or even love it.[/p][p][b]Unfortunately, playspacing has a significant negative impact on the game:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Playspacing actively hurts player retention, driving away new players.[/p][/*][*][p]Playspacing is the main cause of "cheating/hacking" reports (almost every time a claim like this is made, it is a playspacing player), which impacts the reputation of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Playspacing provides people with a massive advantage over people who (for example) don't have the room, or the ability to abuse it.[/p][/*][/list][p]For all the reasons above, we decided a fix was necessary. Together with our beta players, we have tested the fix, which was successful. For many of you, this might be an unwelcome change, but if you want the game to grow and survive, it’s a necessary one. We made sure that in normal play, this fix won’t affect your experience. Only people who try to playspace will notice the impact.[/p][h2]Player Suggestions & Voting[/h2][p]It's been two weeks since we introduced Betahub instead of Discord forums. We're still getting to know the ins & outs as we settle into this system. However, we've noticed a bit of a misunderstanding in the expectations the community suggestions set.[/p][p]Historically, we've used the suggestions to act as a guide when assembling roadmaps, carving a path forward for the game. This will not change. Your suggestions do quite literally shape the game's direction. That being said, providing a suggestion (even when it’s a popular one) doesn't automatically mean it'll be implemented. With developing games, there are a lot of factors to consider, and so, what we want to do, doesn't always align with what we can, or should do, especially since resources aren't infinite.[/p][p]With that in mind, for 2025, we are striving to implement everything that is currently on the new roadmap. In terms of new suggestions, the smaller the scope (think more QOL oriented ideas), the more likely we can fit it in somewhere. The larger in scope, the more unlikely things become, [b]BUT[/b] these could be ideas we can consider for a future roadmap.[/p][p]Now, if you haven't yet, check out the #bugs-and-suggest-btn channel to suggest your ideas, and click the "Full Suggestions List" button to cast your VOTE(S) on ideas you like. You can easily log in with your Discord account, no separate accounts are needed![/p][p][b]Thank you for reading, thank you for playing, and keep an eye out for the next update! Cheers, and HAPPY BREACHING![/b][/p]

notes.title: Flashbang Rework Update! - v30.0
notes.content:
Our Enforcer Flashbang grenades have gotten a rework! From letting players know which enemies are flashed (visually and through sound), slowing flashed enemies, to an increased effective flash duration, and more. We’ve also included Cyclone, Canutt, and Urakan balancing changes!

Check the [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url] to see a full list of changes and improvements in detail.

[h2]Re-introducing, the Flashbang Grenade![/h2]
We’ve gathered a bunch of community feedback to make the flashbang grenade a more effective and reliable tool in the Enforcer’s toolbox. Firstly, when buying a flashbang, you will now receive two instead of one, adding a bit more viability as you can get two uses out of it as opposed to before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/442ce93812bf865752e8a308756ab2a1523e8221.png[/img]

Secondly, we’ve made flashing enemies more reliable, flashing allies less punishing, while also making sure players now move slower when flashed.

Thirdly, we’re also visualizing when players are flashed, alongside a sound cue to let you and your teammates know whether you can make the devastating entrance you had planned.

Last but not least, we added a collection of smaller quality of life features like adding an assist for when a teammate kills an enemy you flashed, better throwing for throwables, or the environment lighting up as a flashbang grenade goes off!

For all details, check the dev-log in our [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url].

[h2]New Comfort Setting![/h2]
To spare players' eyeballs, we’ve also added a new setting in the comfort tab of the in-game options that inverts the flash color. Instead of being graced by a bright white light when getting hit by a flashbang, enabling that option will shroud everything in pitch-blackness instead.

[h2]Balancing Changes![/h2]
With the nature of this update, we’d be remiss if we didn’t add a handful of balancing changes to some of the weapons in the game.
[list]
[*] Cyclone base damage increased by 25%,
[*] Cyclone headshot multiplier reduced from 3x to 2.25x
[*] Canutt damage falloff increased by 10%
[*] Urakan spread reduced by 20%
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/f617c390231d00d007dad55656104c467a26de05.png[/img]

Give the changes a shot (pun most definitely intended), and as always let us know what you think in our [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url]. Any and all feedback is welcome!

Cheers, and see you in the game!

-TF

notes.title: Gloves Update! - v29.0
notes.content:
Glove skins are finally here with a first batch of nine skins! However…they’re not alone. In this new update we’re also introducing you to animated charms, loading screen tips and facts, and we made the necessary preparations for Season 4 of our Competitive mode, where you’ll be fighting for a gorgeous Marui skin!

As always, we also took some time to squash bugs, and included a variety of map fixes ahead of the new season.

Check the [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url] to see a full list of changes and improvements in detail.

[h2]You’re Going to Glove it![/h2]

Glove skins were a much-requested feature from the community, with over a hundred upvotes on the Discord suggestion. It took some time and optimization, but they’re here! The first batch of nine glove skins are now available in the in-game store, ready for you to buy and don!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/5edf8c947bc0f5a6a70ed03d1ed25fc5b3519052.png[/img]

[h2]Introducing: Animated Charms![/h2]

With this update, we’re also expanding our line-up of charms. Decorate your guns with the new Monkey, Toilet, UFO, and Easter Bunny charms, OR go for the new animated charms with the 8-ball and Slot Machine charms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/41949569f77af318b0bcefdab6a8a31781e97fdd.png[/img]

[h2]Welcome to Loading Screen Tips & Facts![/h2]

Another popular community suggestion was to add tips for playing the game, and tidbits of lore to the loading screens, and that’s exactly what we did! Whenever you’re in a loading screen, you’ll now get to see a tip regarding how to play the game, how to do certain things the tutorial doesn’t dive into, or a line or two regarding the lore behind Breachers!

[h2]Competitive Season 4 Preparations![/h2]

A couple of things will change for Season 4 of Competitive. Firstly, the minimum required level to play Competitive will be raised to Level 20 instead of 10, to make sure players know the game a bit more before diving into comp. Secondly, we’re disabling the canceling game feature as there are still people abusing the feature. We’ve seen many requests for the feature to be removed, so we’ll be disabling it to see how that impacts the mode as a whole. Thirdly, plenty of map fixes have also been executed, for a full list, check the changelog in our official Discord.

And last but not least, in Season 4, you’ll be battling for this gorgeous Marui skin with glow animations! Competitive Season 4 starts April 24th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/c4d700820d9997590c5a10f7549ef68bd6c275c3.png[/img]

[h2]Taste the Spring Breeze with the Sakura DLC Bundle![/h2]

Available NOW! Breathe in the delicate vibes of spring with the Sakura Bundle, and let your arsenal bloom and blossom with serene flowery bliss!

These weapon skins were inspired by blossoming cherry trees, effortlessly mixing pink and light blue hues to make for the most zen-looking arsenal you’ve ever seen. They come with pink muzzle flashes complete with flower petals, relaxing sounds, defined by floral springtime designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/5bd9a17e6b2819817afba8b55dc5ffc2b8a536ae.png[/img]

As always, let us know what you think in our [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url], any and all feedback is welcome! Cheers, and see you in the game!

-TF

notes.title: New Gadget: Clone Projector! - v28.0
notes.content:
Not only did we announce our new game, [url=https://www.forefrontvr.com]Forefront[/url], during the VR Games Showcase, we also showed off the first of many new gadgets for Breachers! Even better? That new gadget is AVAILABLE NOW in the game!

Getting new gadgets is something the community has been vocal about for quite some time now. This new update finally brings both Enforcers and Revolters a new toy to play with. But that’s not all. We’re also bringing players brand-new “round over” messages, a much-needed balancing change to incendiary grenades, and a collection of bug fixes and improvements.

Check the [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url] to see a full list of changes and improvements in detail.

[h1]Introducing: the Clone Projector![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/b684f062f1b9a70075d3ab7fab2c48fe5870704f.png[/img]
Trick enemies into thinking you are positioned in places you aren’t, make the enemy reveal their position by shooting at something that only looks like you but isn’t, or make them think you’re planting the EMP. With the [b]Clone Projector[/b], players can place a holographic copy of themselves on various flat surfaces. Upon placing the gadget, a countdown will start for the projector to confirm the pose you want your clone to take (with which you can get creative). Bullets travel through the clone, making it glitch out, but it will stay active until the base of the gadget is destroyed.

It’s an incredibly versatile gadget, and we’re beyond excited to see what strategies our players will come up with!

[h1]Team Ace, Clutch, Flawless, and Thrifty![/h1]
Something else the community has suggested was to expand on the messages that show up at the end of rounds. Previously, we only had “Round Won”, “Round Lost“, and “Ace“. With multiple ideas receiving plenty of upvotes in our Discord, we’ve expanded on these messages:
[list]
[*] [b]Team Ace:[/b] Your team wins the round with one kill on each player's name.
[*] [b]Clutch:[/b] Win the round after at least a 1v2.
[*] [b]Flawless:[/b] Your team wins the round without anyone dying.
[*] [b]Thrifty:[/b] Your team wins the round with a total loadout value that is 50% or lower than the total loadout value of the enemies.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing: Incendiary Grenade![/h1]

Since we reworked the Incendiary Grenade to be more effective in its spreading, it has become a popular choice for player’s loadouts. However, while the rework was necessary, it has now also become quite powerful. This is why the time an Incendiary Grenade burns has been decreased from 15 seconds to 10 seconds. We considered also lowering the damage, but that would ultimately have been too much of a nerf.

As always, let us know what you think in our [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url], any and all feedback is welcome! Cheers, and see you in the game!

-TF

notes.title: Welcome to Competitive Season 3! - v26.0
notes.content:
We’ve got a new epic skin, we’ve added a Competitive Activity Status, improved our incendiary grenades, AND Weekly & Event Challenges are here to keep you on your toes!

Check the [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url] to see a full list of changes and improvements in detail.

[h1]New Season, New Skin![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/505603ee6b6d219e32ee33914be25a6437bbab1c.png[/img]
As always, a new competitive season calls for a brand-new skin to earn! This time around, our Discord community voted which weapon would receive the competitive skin, and the Spectral was the clear winner! It’s also the first competitive skin with an all new design, complete with intricate details that light up when shooting!

[h1]Introducing, Weekly & Event Challenges![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/776ec9e1d4f5d6d2eb3e656302abc6c95339dc0c.png[/img]
The community loved last update's weapon challenges, so we've added Weekly & Event challenges to expand on that. Every week, you'll have new challenges to complete for extra XP. Additionally, Event challenges are arriving as well and might reward you with a free charm when completed!

Keep your eyes peeled for our first Event Challenges soon!

[h1]Say Hello to the Competitive Activity status![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/28ef0723a72e15087c5c66f73a1007cfc52561c8.png[/img]
For Season 3, we've added a Competitive Activity Status in an effort to offer the player some transparency in terms of the queuing population for comp. It will tell you if there's "low", "medium", or "high" activity, and it will guide players toward ideal queuing times as well.

[h1]Incendiary Grenades Improved![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/aa0e397172e03eca7df4a96d60eeb1dcd31f0d48.png[/img]
In certain scenarios, the check responsible for placing incendiary patches, often had difficulties with being obstructed by objects or walls. This resulted in it not placing all the patches. This has now been fixed, making the incendiaries a more attractive option for your loadout.

As always, let us know what you think in our [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url], any and all feedback is welcome! Cheers, and see you in the game!

PS: We’re only getting started for this year. 😉

-TF

notes.title: Introducing: Mall, Charms, Challenges & MORE!
notes.content:
The Holidays are approaching, and we want to close out the year with a bang! This update is a juicy one, and we have tons to cover. Not only are we introducing a brand-new map called, Mall, we also added weapon challenges, level prestige, a huge balancing overhaul, and last but not least, gun charms!

Check the [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url] to see a full list of changes, new features, bug fixes, and improvements in detail.

[h1]Introducing, our new map, Mall![/h1]
Mall is a map that offers players more verticality, and tons of opportunities to go about their rounds. After their initial hideout was dismantled by the ESTF's Enforcers, the Revolters regrouped and rose from the ashes, turning an abandoned mall on the desolate city outskirts into their ultimate headquarters. The mall quickly became the beating heart of the Revolter operation—complete with a black market, a gun range, not to mention their hacker den. And with an armory stocked to the brim and an interrogation room for extracting secrets, this headquarters isn’t just a base; it’s a declaration of defiance.

The Revolters are back—bigger, better, and stronger than ever. But can they defend their home, or will the Enforcers finally be able to extinguish their flame forever?

We’re super excited about our players getting to know this map, as it might be one of our favorites. You can find a full overview of the map blueprints on our site, [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/maps]HERE[/url].

And if you want to see our devs have a go at Bomb Defusal on Mall, you can check that out [url=https://youtu.be/igYwa_636GY]HERE[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/e21ca9fc93bc1d490c37a95e8d8dd9642962cd20.png[/img]

[h1]Say Hello to Gun Charms![/h1]
Gun charms are a new way to decorate your weaponry, and make your guns your own! You can unlock gun charms by completing weapon challenges. Or if you’re feeling fancy, you can head to the in-game store and buy “Fun Charms”, these are gun charms that feature unique sounds that can be triggered, complete with quirky designs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/ff6837ad98f27046e788586c35782640b20c66b1.png[/img]

[h1]Complete our new Weapon Challenges![/h1]
You asked for it, and they are finally here! Weapon Challenges will help you unlock more XP, and even gun charms to further personalize your arsenal. Every gun you can get from the buy menu will have challenges attached to them. Complete them all to maximize your XP output, and unlock gun charms; bronze, silver, and gold miniature versions of the weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/ca4d69825c2ca59192a65224e81b6a4be3dd6822.png[/img]

[h1]Keep Levelling Up: Prestige![/h1]
Rest in peace to the old max level, for it is no more! With the weapon challenges giving you additional XP for your efforts, we wanted to make sure everyone could benefit from it, including our max level players. So, those max level players, will no longer be max level! Players can now prestige, going through all the levels (and the attached rewards) again, again, again, and again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/ee80ab6ad2a0e9b1911c7ddbc9653e2db4814be5.png[/img]

[h1]A Huge Balancing Overhaul![/h1]
We've spent a few weeks refining and tweaking a hefty list of balancing changes, and we are thrilled to finally have these changes in your hands! The changes in question should make SMGs more attractive, the cloaking device less overpowered, and more. We’re eager to get your feedback on these changes!

As always, let us know what you think in our [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url], any and all feedback is welcome! Cheers, and see you in the game!

-TF

notes.title: Welcome to Competitive Season 2! - v24.0
notes.content:
Season 1 of our Competitive mode officially ended. Thank you to all the players that rose through the ranks, and fought to get their rewards! In any case, it’s time for a brand-new season! Welcome to Season 2! Though, a couple of things changed. We have new throwing mechanics, auto pick-up for the EMP is here, rappelling changes, and of course, a new competitive skin to earn!

Check the [Discord](https://www.breachersvr.com/discord) to see a full list of changes and improvements in detail.

[h1]Get ready to earn the Competitive RCP Skin![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/350c8ff39b5953a161f6f689c71acce830a2333e.png[/img]
As always, there’s a skin up for grabs in a competitive season, and this time is no different. We’ve had a Vezin skin in Season Zero, and a Taurus skin in Season 1. For Season 2, we chose to go with an SMG. Get ready to rise through the ranks and earn a shiny new RCP skin!

[h1]New Update, New Throwing![/h1]
We added guided throwing in order to allow players to execute their strategies with more intent. We noticed people often struggle to make their tactical utility land at the location they had in mind, and implemented a solution to combat this. When arming a throwable gadget and reaching out your other hand, a trajectory will appear. Throw the gadget in roughly the same direction, and it should land at the visualized target destination. While we realize this lowers the mechanical skill floor for the interaction, our goal is to increase the skill ceiling for strategic decision-making, by making the desired results more reproducible. Players who don't enjoy the guided throwing can still perform throws using the original method by not reaching out their other hand, or simply disable the feature by turning it off in the settings.

[h1]Auto pick-up for EMP is finally here![/h1]
Gone are the days of digging through guns and gadgets when trying to pick up the EMP. Simply walk over the EMP and you will pick it up, unless you just dropped it, then it'll take a while before you can automatically pick it up again. You can even throw the EMP to a teammate, and they will automatically catch it.

[h1]Say hello to brand-new “Deluxe” DLC Bundles![/h1]
Some of you had already seen the new "Deluxe" skin rarity show up in the in-game store. And now, you know why it was there! These new Deluxe Skins are available in our new DLC bundles, and can be bought in-game with credits, or as DLC on the Meta store (and soon here on Steam as well).

notes.title: New Map: Dam!
notes.content:
Introducing, Dam! Our biggest ever Bomb Defusal and Control Point map to date! Alongside a new map, we’re also introducing a new feature called “Death Recap”, we’re having a new batch of balancing changes, and as per usual, a new wave of fixes and improvements. For the full list of changes, additions, including bug fixes, check the dev-log channel in our [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url]!

[h1]Introducing, Dam![/h1]
Dam is a map full of industrial hallways where long sight lines can be held, and where treacherous angles can result in a tragic loss. Whether the enemies hide near the turbines, the generators, in the security office, server room, or control room, one thing is for sure; you’re in for an intense battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/61feaf60aa2079e22898ee1ac1ef0ad0766935c8.png[/img]

So, what’s the story? The electricity that's generated in this power plant directly supplies ESTF weapon factories in the region, and local wildlife has suffered at the hands of the construction of this complex. With all this in mind, revolters have infiltrated the dam to destroy it. 

Take back control of the dam as enforcers, or complete your destructive objective as revolters. Either way, victory is ripe for the taking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/b5b4010e0508aeac432dd69a73d90aa3b03a0e59.png[/img]

[h1]Say Hello to Death Recap![/h1]
We don’t only have a new map to show off. We're thrilled to introduce a new feature to the game: Death Recap. Previously, we had a kill tracer feature, which allowed players to see a red line indicating the trajectory of the shot that killed them. We decided to build on that.

Players will now also see a snapshot of themselves and their killer at their moment of death.  Additionally, we also added UI elements to display how much damage was taken in each body part, and which weapons were used to inflict that damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/3ea0cbbcca874a648217a40ae2879e9210c4ac7b.png[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] Because of technical limitations, the visual information (what you see in the death recap) is an approximation and might be a little off, especially when playing with high ping or against players with high ping.

[h1]Balancing Changes Are Back![/h1]
We didn’t do any big balancing changes during the competitive update, as it didn’t seem fair to introduce changes when Season 0 was about to start. However, with our eyes on an upcoming update where individual performance will affect SP gain/loss from a competitve match, we’ve made some changes to how player score is calculated.

[list]
[*] [b]Damage:[/b] 1 point awarded for each point of damage dealt to an enemy player.
[*] [b]Kills:[/b] 150/130/110/90/70 points will be awarded for a kill depending on how many enemies are still alive when you scored the kill. 
[*] [b]Multiple kills:[/b] 50 extra points will be awarded for every additional kill you score in the same round.
[*] [b]EMP:[/b] 200 points will be awarded for planting or defusing the EMP.
[/list]

That’s not all, because we’ve also done some weapon changes!

[list]
[*] [b]Spray patterns:[/b] Omen, RCP, Auril, and Marui recoil patterns have been adjusted and, just like the Viper, their vertical recoil no longer caps out after a set amount of bullets.
[*] [b]Incendiary Grenade:[/b] Damage interval has been halved, essentially making them deal damage twice as often. However, the damage per tick was reduced to compensate for the increased tick-rate. Overall, damage output has increased with 30%.
[/list]

For the full list of changes, additions, including bug fixes, check the dev-log channel in our [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url]!

As always, let us know what you think in our Discord. See you, in the game!

notes.title: The Competitive Update - v19.3.2
notes.content:
The Competitive Update is here! We're thrilled to be finally sharing what we've been working on, having people play, and seeing them rise through the ranks from Bronze, all the way to Global Champion.

[h2]NEW CONTENT[/h2]
[list]
[*] Competitive game mode
[*] Ranks for players to achieve (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master, Grand-Master & Global Champion)
[*] Competitive gun skins
[/list]

[h2]BREACHERS COMPETITIVE: HOW DOES IT WORK?[/h2]
[b]Season Zero:[/b] Breachers Competitive will start with “Season Zero”. Despite its name, this is a fully fledged Competitive season equipped with everything you’d expect, from ranks to climb, and rewards to earn. The main reason why we called it Season Zero, is because while we have tested this update rigorously, nothing compares to the real deal: giving it to all our players to be enjoyed. Throughout “Season Zero” certain features and values can still be tweaked to guarantee an optimal player experience. By the time we do the next season, we’ll have perfected our Competitive formula through player and community feedback. Whilst on the topic of seasons, every season will last three months, for a total of four Competitive seasons per year.

[b]Queuing for Competitive: [/b]Players start queuing for a Competitive match in the main menu, either alone, or as a party. While waiting for a match to be found, we wanted our players to be engaged even while queuing, so we implemented the option to let them play Team Deathmatch until a Competitive match has been found. This way, we keep players engaged and playing, while simultaneously warming them up for their upcoming match. While queuing, players can also choose to freely navigate the main menu scene, sort out their skins in the armory, or have a go at the shooting range. When a match is found, the player is transported into a lobby where map voting will take place. After the map has been selected, the players will start their Competitive match and fight for victory.

[b]No ties in Breachers Competitive: [/b]Contrary to Quickplay matches, ties or draws are not possible in Competitive matches. For Competitive, when a tie or draw happens, the highest scoring team will choose which side they play on in an overtime round. Whoever wins that round, then wins the match. When both team scores are also tied, the team who decides which side to play on gets chosen at random at the same odds.

[b]Placement matches & ranks: [/b]For a player to achieve their first rank, they need to complete a total of 5 placement matches. Depending on how you did during these matches, the player’s first rank will be calculated. After that, every game has an impact on the player’s skill point rating. They’ll have the opportunity to climb the ladder and achieve higher ranks, or be unfortunate enough to get demoted. The ranks go from Bronze, to Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master, Grand-Master, all the way to Global Champion.

[b]Competitive Rewards: [/b]Players can earn rewards by rising through the ranks in the form of skins (each representing a rank), and in-game credits. Players do need to complete a minimum amount of 30 matches in a season to be able to claim the rewards they earned. Once that minimum number of matches has been reached, the credits can be claimed immediately, while the skins are awarded at the end of the season. For the rewards, the player’s season high rank is what counts (except for Global Champion, a player will need to be that rank at the end of the season to get the corresponding skin). Players that play more than 50 matches are rewarded with 250 extra in-game credits as a season bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43245638/df5a1e21fa77e9fc6338af2435f9a6f02c776a06.png[/img]

[b]Penalties for abandoning the match: [/b]Players should be warned, because abandoning a Competitive match will result in gradually progressing penalties such as small or large skill point deductions. Additionally, doing so will lock the player out of any online play entirely until the Competitive match they were a part of ends. Players will always have the option to change their mind and rejoin the fight.

Any further questions about Competitive? Feel free to join our Discord, where we have a channel dedicated to asking questions to the team. We do our best to answer as many as we can. [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]https://www.breachersvr.com/discord[/url]

And as always, feel free to leave us any feedback and suggestions. We'd love to see what you all think of this update! Cheers, and see you in the game! Will you become Global Champion?

notes.title: The Skills & Skins Update - 15.0
notes.content:
If you glanced at our roadmap once or twice, you probably deduced that progression was going to be the next thing we’d tackle. Well, here it is, arguably our biggest update yet. We’re excited to introduce you all to the [b]Skills & Skins Update[/b] for Breachers! This update finally opens up the armory for players to buy skins for their weapons, lets players earn XP to level up and earn credits, introduces achievements to unlock, brings gun animations that enhance the weapons, complete with a new wave of balancing changes, further fixes and optimizations. Check out the full changelog in the “dev-log” channel of our [url=http://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url].

[previewyoutube=wLmCl-W5xcc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Armory & Skins[/h2]
A door to the armory has been in the main menu scene since the very beginning, only that door had always been closed. Until now, because you can now enter this new area to purchase skins with your hard-earned (or bought) credits. The interface you’ll get to see here makes it easy to browse, purchase and equip skins to your weapons. We’re looking forward to seeing which skins you all choose to play Breachers in style.

[b]Note for SteamVR 2.0 Beta users:[/b] There’s an issue with in-app purchases on [b]SteamVR 2.0 Beta[/b] where Steam’s pop-up to complete the purchase won’t actually show up. We’re investigating the issue, although this is likely an issue on Steam’s end. In the meantime, if you’d like to make in-app purchases when using SteamVR, we advise you to go back to the stable version instead of the beta version.

[h2]Progression: Earning XP & levelling up[/h2]
Through playing matches, players can now earn XP and level up. At the end of every match, you’ll be greeted with an overview of the XP you gathered while playing, while also indicating how far away you are from progressing to the next level. Upon reaching certain levels, you’ll also be rewarded with credits you can then spend in The Armory to buy skins for your weapons. Who will be the first player to hit level 100?

[h2]Achievements & Gun Animations[/h2]
Are you ready to 100% complete Breachers? A total of 24 achievements have now been added to the game for players to unlock. Get ready to plant 100 EMPs, kill an enemy with breaching foam, and much more to unlock all the achievements Breachers now has to offer.

Gun animations have now been added to our weapons to make them feel even more satisfying and increase the level of immersion in the game.

[h2]Balancing Changes[/h2]
As (almost) always, we have a few balancing changes for you. We try to evaluate balancing in the game on a regular basis, and we will continue gradually adjusting, analyzing and tweaking balancing to better the game. For this update, we have the following in store:
[b]Marui[/b]
- Base damage increased by 7.5%
- Horizontal spread reduced by 50%
[b]Vezin[/b]
- Post-falloff damage reduced by 8.7%
[b]Other[/b]
- Changes to crouching to prevent crouch spamming
- Removed the limitation on the amount of primary weapons kept after buy phase following community feedback

We hope you enjoy this new update. As always, let us know what you think in our [url=http://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url], and be on the lookout for more updates and info on Breachers soon! We can’t wait to share what we still have in store.

notes.title: The Ship Map Update - 14.1.5
notes.content:
Last month, we launched the first major update in our quest to complete the roadmap we envisioned for Breachers. Today, we bring you another major update that continues that journey, introducing the first of the new maps we’ve been developing: Ship! Alongside the new map, we’re also implementing Modulate’s ToxMod to help us better moderate voice chat, a tweak to economy, and a collection of fixes and optimizations. Check out the full changelog in the “dev-log” channel of our [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url].

[h2]Ship: The New Map[/h2]
Introducing, Ship! This new map features an ESTF transport vessel that was discovered by Revolter intelligence. It is suspected of carrying a potentially dangerous payload. Upon closer inspection, you’ll find that each deck of the ship has a distinct purpose. The lowest deck is the beating heart of the ship, with engines and machinery wearing away to keep the vessel moving. On the middle deck, you can find the crew's quarters filled with everything they need to stay operational. Finally, the upper deck is the brain of the craft, dedicated to command and navigation. And if you ever get lost, you can follow the red pipes on the ceiling that always flow towards central hubs near staircases. Ship is playable on Bomb Defusal as well as Control Point, and since this is a brand-new map, it’s likely things about it will still change as we receive more feedback from players. We’re excited to see what you think!

Watch the trailer [url=https://youtu.be/r4HO4xOQFkA]HERE[/url]!

[h2]ToxMod Implementation[/h2]
We already announced this on socials, but we have been working with Modulate to implement their ToxMod solution to increase our ability to identify and review toxic behavior and Rules of Conduct violations that happen in our voice chat. You can think of ToxMod as another player joining in on high-risk voice chats to help us enforce our Code of Conduct. Just like many other players, if ToxMod hears something scary or problematic, it will submit a report. That report will then be reviewed and handled by our team. 

ToxMod will be active in all public servers, (so not in password protected custom servers and party chat). If you have any concerns, feel free to come ask questions in the “questions-for-team” channel in our [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url].

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]
We don’t have many balancing changes this time around, as we’re still analyzing the data and the community’s feedback from our previous changes. However, we did increase the loss bonus from 500 to 1000 credits when losing more than 2 rounds in a row, which should make it easier for teams to come back from a lose-streak. notes.title: The Control Point Update - 13.0.46
notes.content:
If you’ve glanced at our roadmap for Breachers, you know that a lot of exciting things are coming your way. The first major update is now finally here, introducing the new game mode we’ve been working on: Control Point. Besides adding a new game mode, we’re also adding something many of you have asked for in customizable reticle settings, an improved voting menu, more balancing changes, and of course more fixes and optimizations.

[h3]Control Point[/h3]
In Control Point, enforcers and revolters have access to the exact same weapons and gadgets, while both teams will fight to hold designated rooms to gain points. This game mode will be playable on Factory, Hideout, and Skyscraper, as well as on the new map we’re still working on for a future update! We can’t wait to see you all battle it out.

[h3]Customizable Reticle Settings[/h3]
Dive into our new reticle settings to adjust them to your preferences and taste. Change the color and scale to what feels most comfortable and precise to you. This change primarily helps people with colorblindness, while at the same time providing some fun and welcome customization.

[h3]Balancing Changes[/h3]
We see and hear your thoughts on weapons and gadget balancing. And while not every update may have the changes you personally wanted, we’re gradually adjusting, analyzing and tweaking the changes we’re making to better the game. For this update, we have this in store:
[b]- Marui:[/b] Reduced recoil by 10%.
[b]- Healing Syringe:[/b] Increased cost to 450 to better reflect the value you get out of the gadget.
[b]- Drone:[/b] Decreased cost to 200 + increased hit box size to make it a little easier to shoot down.
[b]- Proximity Sensor:[/b] Decreased range from 8 to 5 meters.
[b]- Laser Attachment:[/b] Decreased cost to 50 to better reflect the value of the attachment compared to the others.

As always, these changes are never final. We’re eager to evaluate these changes (and past changes) for the next update, so definitely let us know what you think through Discord!

While this was the first major update of the year, there’s plenty more where that came from, and we can’t wait to ship the next exciting update! As always, let us know what you think in our Discord, and be on the lookout for more updates and info on Breachers!

notes.title: Party Queue & More! - 12.0
notes.content:
One of the most popular suggestions from the community was to introduce a party system into Breachers to make squadding up and playing with friends easier. You asked for it, we deliver! Alongside the party system, this update also introduces the ability to take over bots, an overhaul for the friends list and improvements to recoil. Additionally, there are some more overall tweaks and fixes included as well. For the full list of changes, check out our dev-log channel in [url=breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url]!

[h3]Party Queuing[/h3]
Before this update, it could be quite the hassle to play with your friends. No more. Now, you can send and manage party invites in the revamped Friends Menu of the game and easily join servers together!

[h3]Bot Takeover[/h3]
An opponent just eliminated you, but there's a bot on your team and it's still alive. From this update onward, you can take control of the bot and still turn the tide of battle in your team's favor!

[h3]Recoil & Balancing Changes[/h3]
Changes were made to the recoil systems to make guns feel more controllable. The changes should be most noticeable with the reticles, which won’t jump around as much as they used to. All in all, the changes should make our guns feel even better and should give you as a player a better sense of where your next shot will land. The Marui and Taurus in specific will benefit most from these changes.

In terms of nerfs, the Jesper was nerfed slightly because we felt like it was too strong for a free weapon. Lastly, the Cyclone has been nerfed because it entered territory meant for our SMGs. We’re eager to hear your thoughts!

[h3]A Closer Look at the Future[/h3]
We think it's important to keep developing smaller updates, such as this one, with community-suggested features, fixes and extra polish. But, we're also hard at work to bring you all new maps and of course, our much anticipated Competitive Update. Progress on the first of our new maps has been going steady, although we can't share an ETA on this just yet. The same goes for the Progression Update, which will set the stage for Competitive. We've been making a lot of ground on how everything will work, and we'll be continuing our efforts to make it as great as can be. Additionally, we've started developing gun skins too and can't wait to show them off when we're ready. The next few updates are the big ones you’re all waiting for!

Regardless, we hope you enjoy the update. Let us know what you think in our  [url=breachersvr.com/discord]Discord[/url], and be on the lookout for more updates and info on Breachers!

Breachers officially launched two weeks ago, and we’re thrilled by the positive response of our players. We’d like to extend a big thank you to everyone playing the game. notes.title: Launch Details!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We'd like to start by saying THANK YOU on behalf of the entire team at Triangle-Factory. This was the best game launch we could have hoped for.
We are committed to making Breachers the best multiplayer shooter out there and the team is excited to get started on all the features that are yet to come.

[h2]About the launch[/h2]
We are thrilled with all the positive reviews, feedback, fantastic videos and the large number of players in the game. The entire team was glued to the screen, looking at the amount of players rise.. and rise... and rise even more!
The launch went extremely smooth, even though some users experienced minor issues with our services. Don't worry, we're looking into these problems and we'll get them sorted out for you as soon as possible. If you encounter problems, hit us up on our discord (breachersvr.com/discord).
Additionally, we got reports that some users had their pre-orders automatically cancelled, which prevented them from receiving their pre-order skin. If this happened to you, don't worry. We can still activate your skin if you email us (support@triangle-factory.be) with your proof of pre-order and your support code (found in the game under settings -> support).
Due the amount of servers our server browser can act weird and only show one server. Just click "enable high ping servers" to view all the servers. They might show as 999 ping but they aren't. We're of course fixing this asap.

[h2]What's next for Breachers?[/h2]
Glad you asked! While we cannot yet provide a detailed timeline, we can share some information about what's coming up. We are currently working on two new maps, which are very different from the four maps currently in the game. We are also developing a new game mode.
Our first big update will focus on the "Competitive" mode. This means that players will be able to queue up for ranked matches and receive a rating that expresses their skill level. We are still finalizing the details of this mode, but we are excited to see how it will enhance the game.

A content update like we described above will take some time. Don't worry though, we will still push minor updates that will fix issues or improve some already existing features.
Finally, we want to share some statistics with you. Even though the game has only been out for less than 24 hours at the time of writing, we are impressed by some of the numbers we've seen. Here are some highlights:

[list]
[*]11,000 frag grenade kills
[*]45,000 healing syringe uses
[*]322,000 player deaths
[*]34,000 teams eliminated
[*]555 breaching foam kills
[/list]


Once again, we want to thank you all for the amazing launch of Breachers. Please feel free to stop by our Discord (breachersvr.com/discord) and let us know what you think!
See you in the game!

-Triangle Factory

notes.title: Release Date and Launch Supporter Reward for Breachers
notes.content:
[h1]Breachers release date & "Elite" Jesper skin Launch Supporter Reward![/h1]

Over 60,000 people have played the Breachers open alpha, and we are beyond grateful for the community's suggestions, feedback and overall response. [b]We are excited to announce that Breachers will launch on steam with a Launch Supporter Reward; the "Elite" Jesper gun skin, for those who buy the game in the first 48 hours after release![/b] Make sure to wishlist Breachers to get a notification, so you don't miss out on the reward!

Additionally, we're equally thrilled to reveal the actual release date of the game; [b]Breachers will officially launch on April 13th.[/b]

The JESPER is the standard side-arm players spawn with at the start of a round, and with this skin it has never looked better.

[h1]The End of the Open Alpha[/h1]
With the Launch Supporter Reward announced and an official release date inching closer, the [b]open alpha will come to a close on March 24th.[/b] Don't miss out on your chance to try out Breachers before it goes live on April 13th! More details on the alpha in our Discord: [url=https://www.breachersvr.com/discord]breachersvr.com/discord[/url]!
